name: Immersive initiation retreat accommodation
notes:
Immersive initiation retreat (later stage). A few small decks and huts on the hillside so people can stay several days down in the deep jungle, close to the valley floor. Purpose: rites-of-passage and initiation retreats, kids' retreats and healing retreats, learned in collaboration with Dr Arne Rubinstein (Rites of Passage Institute) after the Gathering of Men.
Build light: small decks on screw piles or timber stumps, no slabs; hand-carried materials; huts that can be packed down. Keep every structure out of the gully vine forest (of-concern, fire-sensitive regional ecosystem) and back from the creek.
Access: one footpath on contour (≤10% grade) with a safe route out at night and in wet weather.
Services: composting toilets, rain tank, no fires near the vine forest; a cleared low-fuel space around the decks.
Before building or hosting: council approval for short-term or tourist accommodation, building rules for the decks, bushfire requirements, insurance; for kids' programs, Working with Children (Blue Card) checks, a child-safety policy and first aid.
Teepee and gathering space nearby (see the teepee point).
